entries.name: security-review
entries.description: Every worker reviews your change for security problems only; findings merged with agreement counts, like farmout review.

entries.name: test-gaps
entries.description: Lists the behaviours in your uncommitted change that no test covers, with the test to add for each.

entries.name: guard-secrets
entries.description: Stops a task before it starts if it would hand a worker a secrets file (.env, private keys, credentials, also inside listed folders) or a brief that holds a private key.

entries.name: notify
entries.description: Tells you when a session's turn or a pipeline ends: a desktop notification, and a push to your phone through ntfy if NTFY_TOPIC is set.

entries.name: prune
entries.description: Deletes sessions with no turn in more than N days (default 14), with their worktrees and branches. --dry-run lists them first.
